config_files.notes: Primary configuration file containing [Graphics], [Options], [Input], and [Language] sections.
Steam releases use the same document directory as Ubisoft Connect.
Xbox Game Pass for PC edition stores settings in the standard user document directory.

keys.notes: Recommended 0 (Off) across all goals and hardware tiers. On ultrawide and high refresh rate displays (such as 32:9 240Hz), motion blur creates severe peripheral smearing and is the leading cause of eye fatigue and motion sickness.

keys.effect: Depth of field camera effect during gameplay and interactions. 0=Off, 1=On.
keys.notes: Disabling DoF prevents unnatural peripheral blurring and reduces eye strain when scanning wide panoramic views on ultrawide monitors.

keys.effect: Aspect ratio constraint. 0=Disabled (allow native ultrawide 21:9 and 32:9 rendering in gameplay), 1=Enabled (force 16:9 pillarboxing).
keys.notes: Essential for ultrawide users. When set to 0, gameplay fills the entire ultrawide aspect ratio (e.g. 5120x1440). Setting to 1 forces black bars.

keys.effect: Automatic field of view adjustment based on display aspect ratio. 0=Off, 1=On.
keys.notes: Maintains correct horizontal-plus (Hor+) FOV scaling on 21:9 and 32:9 displays without cutting off vertical visibility.

keys.effect: Field of view scaling multiplier. Default is 1.00000 (100%). In-game slider maps between 0.85 and 1.15.
keys.notes: On super ultrawide (32:9) setups, values higher than 1.00 can cause noticeable fish-eye edge distortion. Keeping 1.00000 with AutoFOV=1 provides an optimal, undistorted panoramic field of view.

keys.effect: Enables (1) or disables (0) the internal frame rate limiter.
keys.notes: The in-game limiter enforces a hard 90 FPS ceiling in the Anvil engine. Setting IsFpsLimitEnabled=1 restricts gameplay to 90 FPS regardless of the MaxFPS value. Recommended 0 (disabled in-game); use GPU driver (NVIDIA Control Panel Max Frame Rate) to lock 120 or 144 FPS.

keys.effect: In-game frame rate limiter ceiling. The in-game slider and engine enforce a hard cap of 90 FPS.
keys.notes: Values set above 90 in the INI are clamped back to 90 by the engine on launch or whenever display settings are saved in-game. To play above 90 FPS on a 240Hz monitor, set IsFpsLimitEnabled=0 and cap framerate via GPU driver.
Disable in-game VSync and rely on G-Sync / FreeSync VRR in the GPU control panel for tear-free gameplay without input lag.

Ubisoft Anvil volumetric clouds at Ultra (2) are extremely computationally heavy on GPU compute shaders. Dropping from 2 to 1 improves framerate stability by 12–15% at 1440p/ultrawide with negligible visual difference.

keys.effect: Shadow map resolution and cascade filter quality. 0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High, 3=Very High, 4=Ultra, 5=Ultra High.
keys.notes: Setting 5 (Ultra High) imposes a steep performance cost during outdoor daylight roaming. Setting 4 delivers crisp shadow edges while recovering vital frame pacing overhead at ultrawide resolutions.
High/Very High TAA is crucial at 5120x1440 to eliminate specular pixel crawl and sub-pixel foliage shimmer, significantly reducing visual fatigue.
Ultra (4) textures require ~6–8 GB VRAM. Safe and recommended on 12 GB+ GPUs (like RTX 4070 SUPER).
Keeps Fenyx and NPC textures sharp. No measurable framerate difference on GPUs with adequate VRAM.
Value 2 provides full 16x anisotropic filtering, keeping ground and cliff textures sharp when viewed at oblique angles on wide panoramas.

keys.effect: Environmental geometry detail and view distance. 0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High, 3=Very High, 4=Ultra, 5=Ultra High.
keys.notes: Determines distant landmark rendering across the Golden Isle. High-end hardware can sustain setting 5.
Maintains high polygon detail on Fenyx, creatures, and mythical bosses.

keys.effect: Particle effects, divine power magic, and fire rendering quality. 0=Low to 5=Ultra.
keys.notes: Controls density and resolution of Godly powers and combat visual fx.

keys.effect: Water surface physics and rendering detail. 0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High.
keys.notes: Governs coastal water and lake wave displacement.

keys.effect: Weather rain particle density and wet surface reflections. 0=Low to 3=High.
keys.notes: Full rain effects add immersion without significant GPU overhead on high-end cards.
Provides natural shading under foliage, rocks, and buildings to avoid a flat look.
Keep 0 (Off) for a quality goal to guarantee constant native pixel sharpness on 5120x1440 panels.

keys.effect: Internal render resolution scaling factor. 1.00000 = 100% native resolution.
keys.notes: Maintain 1.00000 for pixel-perfect display clarity.

Confirmed via in-game menu screenshot: Fullscreen=1, Borderless=2, Windowed=3. Use WindowMode=1 (Fullscreen). When combined with DXVK dxvk.allowFse=True, DXVK promotes the swapchain to Vulkan exclusive fullscreen (VK_PRESENT_MODE_IMMEDIATE_KHR) at the driver layer. The game engine still reports 'Borderless' in the benchmark results panel — this is expected and correct; FSE is active at the Vulkan level.
Enable if using an HDR-capable monitor. Calibrate peak luminance and paper white in-game for comfortable contrast.
Setting 2 populates dense grass and flowers across the landscape.
High setting maintains smooth terrain surfaces at long distances.
Can be toggled to 0 if sensitive to bright glare and high-contrast light bleeds in HDR mode.

engine_overrides.behaviour: The in-game options menu frame limiter slider caps at 90 FPS maximum, and the engine enforces this as an internal hard ceiling. If IsFpsLimitEnabled=1 is set, the engine clamps MaxFPS back to 90 on launch or whenever in-game display settings are saved.
engine_overrides.action: Set IsFpsLimitEnabled=0 in ImmortalsFenyxRising.ini to disable the in-game limiter. Apply a driver-level FPS cap via NVIDIA Control Panel (Max Frame Rate). For 240Hz G-Sync setups, cap at 237 FPS to stay within the VRR window while preventing runaway GPU oscillation.

engine_overrides.behaviour: If KeepStandardAspect is enabled (1), the engine forces a 16:9 pillarbox window, disabling ultrawide gameplay rendering.
engine_overrides.action: Ensure KeepStandardAspect=0 is set in the INI to enable full panoramic 21:9 or 32:9 rendering in gameplay.

engine_overrides.behaviour: Enum mapping is game-specific and differs from many other Ubisoft Anvil titles. Confirmed via in-game menu: 1=Fullscreen, 2=Borderless, 3=Windowed.
engine_overrides.action: Set WindowMode=1 (Fullscreen). When paired with DXVK allowFse=True, the Vulkan swapchain is promoted to exclusive fullscreen regardless of the D3D11 surface type the game engine creates.

manual_only_settings.location: Options → Display → Field of View (85% to 115%)
manual_only_settings.reason: On 32:9 super ultrawide, pushing FOV above 100% introduces heavy peripheral distortion ('fish-eye'), which strains peripheral vision. 100% provides natural perspective.

manual_only_settings.recommendation: Center HUD or adjust margins to 16:9 bounds
manual_only_settings.reason: Reduces extreme neck and eye scanning toward the far corners of a 49-inch 32:9 monitor during intense combat.

manual_only_settings.recommendation: Set Paper White to 200–300 nits; Peak Luminance to match monitor spec (e.g. 1000 nits)
manual_only_settings.reason: Prevents blown-out UI highlights and visual fatigue during night-to-day transitions.
Automatic camera recentring can cause visual disorientation and vestibular friction during platforming and puzzles.

intro_skip.label: Rename startup splash videos
intro_skip.notes: Directly skips the Ubisoft opening logos and legal warning videos to boot faster to the main menu. Verified safe on Ubisoft Connect and Steam versions.

dxvk.version_notes: DXVK 3.1 (released 2026-08-29) is the minimum recommended version. DXVK 2.3.1 does not support VK_EXT_swapchain_colorspace on NVIDIA drivers — HDR is silently inert (swapchain runs in R8G8B8A8_UNORM / SDR). DXVK 3.1 adds the allowFse flag which, when combined with WindowMode=1 (Fullscreen), activates the VK_EXT_full_screen_exclusive path, unlocking HDR (R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT / EXTENDED_SRGB_LINEAR_EXT) and VRR direct flip.
config_notes: dxvk.allowFse=True is mandatory for HDR on NVIDIA. Without it, VK_EXT_swapchain_colorspace is not negotiated and the swapchain runs in SDR regardless of dxgi.enableHDR.
dxvk.latencySleep=Auto engages VK_NV_low_latency2 (NVIDIA Reflex) when supported. Confirmed active on RTX 4070 SUPER / NVIDIA 616.64.
dxgi.maxFrameLatency=0 (no override) is correct when NVIDIA Reflex (latencySleep=Auto) is active. Setting to 1 creates redundant latency management that conflicts with Reflex frame timing.
d3d11.enableRt and dxvk.gpuQueuePriority are valid parsed keys in DXVK 3.1 — confirmed in Effective configuration log output. These were not present in DXVK 2.3.1 upstream dxvk.conf.
dxvk.enableAsync=False is required for Ubisoft/Anvil engines. Async pipeline compilation causes mid-frame stalls on Anvil due to its synchronous shader usage pattern.
dxvk.hud and dxvk.debug should be commented out for normal play — debug logging writes to disk every frame.

The DXVK pipeline shader cache (AppData\Local\dxvk\*.dxvk.bin) builds progressively. Expect worst-frame-time hitches in early sessions. Cache matures to ~7000+ shaders after 2-3 hours of varied gameplay.

nvidia_app_settings.notes: Per-game profile recommended in NVIDIA App for Immortals Fenyx Rising.

settings.reason: Set to On (not Ultra) when dxvk.latencySleep=Auto is active. Reflex (VK_NV_low_latency2) supersedes Ultra mode. Running both simultaneously creates conflicting latency management.
For 240Hz G-Sync panels: 3 FPS below max refresh rate keeps GPU within the VRR window and prevents runaway oscillation above 240Hz.
Engages VRR adaptive sync. Combined with in-game VSyncMode=0 and NVCP VSync=On, provides tear-free adaptive frame delivery.
Driver-level VSync ON is required for G-Sync to function as a ceiling above the VRR range. In-game VSync must be OFF simultaneously.
Prevents GPU clock step-down during lighter scenes, reducing the clock oscillation that causes frame time spikes.
RTX HDR synthesises HDR from SDR. With DXVK delivering native R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT HDR, enabling RTX HDR would double-process the signal and corrupt tone mapping.
Frame interpolation adds display latency. Incompatible with G-Sync and Reflex latency goals.

notes: Native 21:9 and 32:9 ultrawide gameplay support is available when KeepStandardAspect=0.
Cutscenes and certain pre-rendered story cinematics remain 16:9 pillarboxed by design.

Volumetric clouds (Cloud=2) and Ultra High Shadows (Shadow=5) are the primary GPU bottlenecks in the Anvil engine. Dropping Cloud to 1 and Shadow to 4 yields substantial frame pacing stability on high-resolution setups without perceived quality loss.
Eye comfort on 32:9 monitors requires disabling MotionBlur (MotionBlur=0) and Depth of Field (DOF=0) to eliminate smearing and artificial focal struggle in the user's peripheral vision.
WindowMode enum for this title: 1=Fullscreen, 2=Borderless, 3=Windowed. Confirmed via in-game Settings screenshot. Differs from many other Anvil/Ubisoft titles where 0=Fullscreen.

The benchmark results panel reports 'Borderless' even when running WindowMode=1 with DXVK allowFse. This is a game-engine reporting artefact — DXVK presents a borderless D3D11 surface to the game while the Vulkan layer uses VK_PRESENT_MODE_IMMEDIATE_KHR (exclusive fullscreen). VRR, HDR, and direct flip are all active.
Benchmarked on RTX 4070 SUPER / Ryzen 7 5800X3D at 5120x1440: AVG ~87 FPS, MIN improves from ~3 FPS (cold shader cache) to ~27 FPS (warm cache) after 2-3 sessions.
